title: sail-tells-builder-to-use-moreabout
intention: Add a line to /sail's SKILL.md telling the builder: if the prebuild packet is not adequate, fire /moreabout to get what you need before proceeding.
why: The prebuild's learning door (/moreabout) exists but the build prompt doesn't point at it, so the builder never reaches for it. The learning loop is unwired — the door is built but nobody knows to knock.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver spent on the novel, not re-deriving the settled — /moreabout exists to prevent re-derivation during a build). The shrinking-footprint derivation (the prebuild packet should carry enough that the build doesn't need to re-explore).

falsifier.proves_red: Done when /sail's SKILL.md names /moreabout as the reach-for when context is thin. Wrong intent if the builder should NOT be allowed to expand context mid-build (would need a ruling).
